meta.description: Held-out texts: written on 2026-10-10 before the reworded Jev levels were tried on anything, and never used to choose wording. All names, numbers and links are fictional.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Netflix: Your payment was declined and your membership will be cancelled today. Update your card details now: netflix-billing-help.com/update

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Grandpa it's Tyler. I lost my wallet on my trip and need $300 for a bus ticket home. Can you send it to my friend's Cash App, $jay-pays-22? Please don't tell Mom.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: DHL: Your parcel is being held at customs. Pay the $2.40 duty within 12 hours or it will be returned to sender: dhl-customs-release.info

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Apple Security: Your Apple ID was used to sign in on a new device in Miami. If this was not you, call Apple Support right away at (555) 019-2231.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Congratulations! You are today's winner of a $500 Costco voucher. Enter your card number to cover the $1 verification charge: costco-winners.co

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hi, this is Dan from the Chase fraud team. We just sent you a 6-digit code to confirm it's really you. Reply with the code so we can secure your account.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: SSA NOTICE: Your Social Security number has been suspended because of suspicious activity. Call (555) 017-9920 immediately to avoid legal action.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hello, I'm Mr. Li from the Golden Harbor investment group. Our members made 40% last week on gold tokens. Only a few places left, send 0.05 BTC today to join.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hi Dad, I dropped my phone in the sink so I'm using a friend's phone. I need to pay my rent today and my banking app is locked. Can you transfer $1,150? I'll send you the account details.
